changelog.content:
## Changes
+ **Subscriptions: smarter search recovery.** Renamed the polling page to Subscription Settings, added a configurable search page size, and retry missing episodes with `E01`-style episode keywords when the broad search does not find a match.
+ **Search results: MTeam download status.** Updated the MTeam SDK integration so search results can show whether a torrent is not downloaded, downloading, or already downloaded.
+ **Downloads UI polish.** Long torrent titles and save paths now keep the original truncation style while supporting hover, keyboard focus, and tap-to-open full-text tooltips; download cards no longer show torrent hashes and use a tighter progress/speed/ETA layout.
+ **Download routing and operations.** Added variety/seeding save paths with category-aware download routing, plus backup export and restore for app data.
+ **fnTV and reverse-proxy support.** Added fnTV Intro Skipper auto intro/outro detection and support for hosting PT Buddy behind a reverse-proxy subpath.
+ **Release and reliability fixes.** Shrunk release binaries with strip/thin-LTO/gzipped UI assets, defaulted release logging to info while honoring `RUST_LOG`, restored the embedded static asset placeholder test path, and added the missing `episode_correction_mode` migration.
